## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.6

- Fixes global fallback and override light/dark list-thread colors with synchronized native color inputs backed by Style Settings' persistent text variables, so selections commit, close, reset, and survive reopening.
- Adds a disabled-by-default **Thread separate list blocks that are only separated by a blank line** option beneath **Active List Item Threading**, independent from the matching All Branches option.
- Adds enabled-by-default **Active Orphan List Threading** and **Active Orphan List Item Threading**, plus disabled-by-default **All Branches of an Active Orphan List Threading**, for ordered and unordered blocks without unmarked heads.
- Renders orphan root paths in Live Preview, Source mode, and Reading mode, including single root items and complete root sibling groups.
- Prevents intermittent far-right overdraw by drawing inferred continuation/gutter spines only when **Connect separate list blocks** is explicitly enabled.
- Renames the static-guide section to **List Static Tree Indentation Guides**, adopts **List Threading** terminology throughout, and changes the blank-line option's wording from “Treat” to “Thread.”
- Retains 1.0.5 setting choices through legacy-key migration, searchable settings, synchronized precise Style Settings number inputs, viewport-only editor work, and GitHub-attested release assets.
